title: The plan step and the worker role file name _anchors.csv for a reworded DOC fact
goal: Plan step 2 of skills/sprint/SKILL.md names a kb root's _anchors.csv beside expansions.csv as a touch of an item that rewords or adds a DOC fact while agents/worker.md tells a worker that rewords or adds a DOC fact to re-anchor it with factdiff.py anchor --file

run: import sys;a=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines();b=open('agents/worker.md',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines();x=any('expansions.csv' in l and '_anchors.csv' in l for l in a);y=any('factdiff.py anchor' in l for l in b);print('plan step names _anchors.csv:',x,'worker role re-anchors:',y);sys.exit(0 if x and y else 1)
